nodes.label: Dart Analyzer Configuration
nodes.rationale: Generated platform directories (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux, build) are excluded from analysis because they are tool-generated rather than hand-maintained.

nodes.label: Flutter Web index.html Shell
nodes.rationale: base href is the $FLUTTER_BASE_HREF placeholder replaced by --base-href at build time so the app can be served from a subpath.

nodes.label: api_service.dart (HTTP Client to Backend)
nodes.rationale: baseUrl must be 10.0.2.2 on the Android emulator, or the PC LAN IP for a physical phone on the same Wi-Fi.

nodes.label: POST /chat Endpoint
nodes.rationale: session_id identifies the conversation so the agent's per-session memory can keep follow-up context.

nodes.label: Indexing Pipeline (Chunk, Embed, Index)
nodes.rationale: Splitting documents into small chunks before embedding keeps retrieved context focused enough to fit the LLM prompt.

nodes.label: Agentic Multimodal RAG
nodes.rationale: Classic RAG uses a fixed retrieve-then-generate pipeline; making the retrieval agentic lets an LLM plus tools and memory decide what to search and when, and going multimodal lets answers be grounded in images as well as text.

nodes.label: CLIP (ViT-B-32) Image Embeddings
nodes.rationale: CLIP maps text queries and images into one embedding space, so an image can be found from a text query; run via sentence-transformers.

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
nodes.rationale: A standard tool/data protocol avoids hand-writing every external integration into the agent.

nodes.label: Ollama Local LLM/VLM Runtime
nodes.rationale: Running llama3.2 and llama3.2-vision locally keeps data on the developer's machine.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Database
nodes.rationale: Two cosine-distance collections, texts (1024-dim, BGE-M3) and images (512-dim, CLIP), keep each modality's vectors separate while still searchable.

nodes.label: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
nodes.rationale: LLMs only know their training data and hallucinate; grounding answers in chunks retrieved from the user's own documents fixes this.

nodes.label: ReAct Agent Loop
nodes.rationale: Alternating reasoning and actions lets the agent pick tools step by step instead of following a hard-coded retrieval flow.

nodes.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
nodes.rationale: Text and image rankings have incomparable scores, so RRF merges them by rank position (score(d) = sum 1/(k + rank), k = 60) instead of by raw similarity.

nodes.label: Semantic Search / Cosine Similarity
nodes.rationale: Chunks are compared by vector angle, so with normalized vectors similarity reduces to a dot product; matches are by meaning rather than keywords.

nodes.label: Source Citations (File and Page)
nodes.rationale: Citing the file and page makes grounded answers verifiable and distinguishes them from hallucinated ones.

nodes.label: Streaming Answers via Server-Sent Events (Planned)
nodes.rationale: Streaming removes the wait for a full answer, giving a typing effect.
